name: Galaxy S8

images.credit: DoerNoc, CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Body.Weight: S8: 155 g, S8+: 173 g, S8 Active: 208 g
Body.Other: Physical sound volume keys, Bixby key

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android Nougat, Android 7.0 "Nougat" with Samsung Experience 8.1, Current: Android Pie, Android 9 "Pie" with One UI Version 1.0 (without Project Treble, Treble), Unofficial alternative: One UI 2, Android 11, Android 12, Android 13
Platform.CPU: Exynos: Octa-core (4×2.3 GHz M2 Mongoose & 4×1.7 GHz) Cortex-A53 (GTS), Snapdragon: Octa-core (4×2.45 GHz Kryo & 4×1.9 GHz Kryo)
Platform.GPU: Exynos: Mali (GPU), Mali-G71 MP20, Snapdragon: Adreno 540

Memory.Storage: 64 GB UFS 2.1 / UFS 2.0 in some devices

Display.Display: 2960×1440 1440p Super AMOLED capacitive touchscreen display, HDR10, S8 and S8 Active: 5.8 in, 225 ppcm (572 pixels per inch, ppi), S8+: 6.2 in, 208 ppcm (529 ppi)(both Diamond PenTile)

Cameras.Rear camera: 12 (1.4), f/1.7, OIS, 4K at 30 fps, 1440p at 30fps, 1080p at 60 fps, 720p at 30 fps, slow motion 720p at 240 fps

Sound.Sound: Sound and audio features e.g. speaker(s), audio jack, vibration motor, etc.

Battery.Battery: Non-removable S8: 3000 mAh, S8+: 3500 mAh, S8 Active: 4000 mAh - all 15 Watts
Battery.Charging: Fast charging up to 9W, Qi wireless charging

Connectivity.Connectivity: Physical and wireless e.g. USB type-C, Bluetooth 5.0 (LE up to 2 Mbit/s), 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac (2.4/5GHz) WiFi, NFC, location (GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, BeiDou)
